info.name: Dispatch Files API v1 Appointments API

description.content:
The Dispatch Files API stores photos and other files associated with a job, and is served from a host distinct from the core Dispatch REST API. Files are uploaded as multipart/form-data and retrieved by UID, which redirects to the stored object.
